payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline experiments conducted in the context of speech translation, including pre-training and multi-task settings.

claims.text: Pre-training baselines include encoder pre-training from an ASR model, decoder pre-training from an MT model, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
Multi-task baselines consist of one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
The vanilla ST baseline consists of only a speech encoder and a decoder.
Competitive baselines were reproduced for fair comparison due to different data pre-processing methods used by participants.
